a depictive/about of-phrase on a non-deverbal noun ("posters of Saddam Hussein", the same shape as the explicitly excluded "a photo of Mary"): Possession is barred and the nominalization-object rule does not apply, so no positive encoding is specified
notes: The rule form, the strength 0.9/0.9, the non-fused size modifier "giant" and the exposed adjectival modifier genus on public_place all follow the instruction set as written. The entity-attached (Of ...) oblique is a reasonable fill for the uncovered of-phrase, not an invented head.
